ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid='package-add'] in admin edit mode does NOT fire POST /api/packages. The button is rendered, visible, enabled, and clickable; force-click does not raise — but no network request is initiated and no toast appears. Backend endpoint works (verified by pytest test_admin_create_then_delete_package). Likely an event-handler wiring issue in BuchungPage.jsx around line 187–224 — possibly the onClick is being shadowed by the visual editor's wrapper, or `creatingPackage` is stuck, or the api.post promise is being swallowed. Suggest: (a) add console.log inside the onClick, (b) verify `api` import resolves to the same base as PATCH calls (which do work), (c) confirm `disabled={creatingPackage}` is not stuck true after a failed previous click.

Spec asked for inline-editing of buchung_overline_de / title / intro on /buchung. Could not locate any element with data-cms-path='buchung_overline_de' or data-cms-key='buchung_overline_de'. Either the Editable wrapper is mounted under a different attribute, or the testid/path was renamed. Please confirm and expose a stable selector so admin/QA can target the overline field.

rca of the issue: Frontend bug only: BuchungPage +Paket button click does not generate any network traffic. Repro: login admin → /buchung → click 'Live' to enable edit mode → click [data-testid='package-add'] → wait 4s → no POST /api/packages observed. Backend POST /api/packages itself works (verified by pytest creating slug 'qa-test-paket-*' end-to-end). RCA hypothesis: (a) the inline async-arrow onClick is being shadowed by the visual-editor wrapper element so React's synthetic click isn't reaching it; or (b) `creatingPackage` state stuck true blocking subsequent attempts; or (c) the api.post promise throws synchronously without logging. Mitigation: add explicit console.log/console.error in onClick body, confirm `api` import works (it does for PATCH calls in same file), and consider lifting the onClick to a named function outside the JSX to ensure no closure/HMR issue.
